s0201.literal: The Taicang Supervisory Office was established, rank five.
s0201.idiomatic: The Taicang supervisory office was established at rank five.

s0202.literal: Jianning, Leizhou, Fengzhou, Lianzhou, Huazhou, and Gaozhou were reorganized as routes; Zhaoqing Route was placed under Guangnan West Circuit, and Xiazhou Route was moved to its former seat north of the river.
s0202.idiomatic: Jianning, Leizhou, Fengzhou, Lianzhou, Huazhou, and Gaozhou were made routes; Zhaoqing Route was placed under Guangnan West Circuit, and Xiazhou Route was moved back to its former seat north of the river.

s0203.literal: Zhang County was restored and placed under Gongchang Route.
s0203.idiomatic: Zhang County was restored and placed under Gongchang Route.

s0204.literal: Lingbi County of Suzhou was again placed under Guide.
s0204.idiomatic: Lingbi County of Suzhou was again placed under Guide.

s0205.literal: This year, one hundred two persons were sentenced to death.
s0205.idiomatic: That year, one hundred two persons were sentenced to death.

s0206.literal: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, on the wuxu new moon, King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched his signatory privy councilor Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and also present the annual tribute.
s0206.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the wuxu new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent his signatory privy councilor Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and present the annual tribute.

s0207.literal: On xinchou day Alaghan, Fan Wenhu, and Nangadai were summoned together to court to receive instruction; Batu, Zhang Gui, and Li Ting were left behind.
s0207.idiomatic: On xinchou day Alaghan, Fan Wenhu, and Nangadai were summoned to court together for instruction; Batu, Zhang Gui, and Li Ting were left in charge.

s0208.literal: Xindu and Hong Chajiu were ordered to lead their armies overland to Japan, while arms and armor were shipped by boat; the prefectures and counties along the route were to supply their grain.
s0208.idiomatic: Xindu and Hong Chajiu were ordered to march their armies overland to Japan while arms and armor went by ship; prefectures and counties along the route were to supply grain.

s0209.literal: At Fan Wenhu's recommendation, ten thousand Han troops were added.
s0209.idiomatic: On Fan Wenhu's recommendation, ten thousand Han troops were added.

s0210.literal: Wenhu also requested two thousand horses for Tusihusi's army and the Muslim catapult makers.
s0210.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu also asked for two thousand horses for Tusihusi's army and the Muslim catapult makers.

s0211.literal: The Emperor said: "What use are these on warships?
s0211.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "What use are these on warships?

s0213.literal: On guimao day paper money and gold and silver were issued to Boluo to give to the poor.
s0213.idiomatic: On guimao day paper money and gold and silver were issued to Boluo for relief of the poor.

s0214.literal: On dingwei day he hunted in the near suburbs.
s0214.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Emperor hunted near the capital.

s0215.literal: An edict ordered Jiangnan prefectures and commanderies jointly to employ Mongols and Muslims.
s0215.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jiangnan prefectures and commanderies to employ Mongols and Muslims together.

s0216.literal: All darughachis that should be established under the various princes were ordered to come to court, and the princes Azhiji and others were also instructed by edict.
s0216.idiomatic: All darughachis due to be posted under the various princes were ordered to court, and princes including Azhiji were notified by edict.

s0217.literal: On jiyou day Yangluo Fort of Huang Prefecture was again placed under E Prefecture.
s0217.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yangluo Fort of Huang Prefecture was again placed under E Prefecture.

s0218.literal: On xinhai day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.
s0218.idiomatic: On xinhai day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar on the Emperor's behalf.

s0219.literal: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent envoys saying Japan had violated his border and asking for troops to pursue them; an edict granted him five hundred troops garrisoning the Jinzhou pass.
s0219.idiomatic: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo reported that Japan had raided his border and asked for troops to pursue them; an edict gave him five hundred troops from the Jinzhou pass garrison.

s0220.literal: On bingchen day the imperial carriage visited Hu Prefecture.
s0220.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Emperor visited Hu Prefecture.

s0221.literal: The Seal Bureau was changed to the Directorate of Sacred Regalia, and the official seals of offices throughout the realm were collected.
s0221.idiomatic: The seal bureau was renamed the directorate of sacred regalia, and official seals from offices throughout the realm were collected.

s0222.literal: On dingsi day a decree made sixth-generation Li Quanyou succeed fifth-generation Li Jushou in sacrificing to the Dipper.
s0222.idiomatic: On dingsi day a decree made Li Quanyou of the sixth generation succeed Li Jushou of the fifth generation in sacrificing to the Dipper.

s0223.literal: On guihai day Gao Rixin of Shaowu, holding Longlou Stockade in rebellion, was captured.
s0223.idiomatic: On guihai day Gao Rixin of Shaowu, who had seized Longlou Stockade in rebellion, was captured.

s0224.literal: Xindu and others were rewarded for battle merit, and the armies campaigning against Japan were granted paper money.
s0224.idiomatic: Xindu and others were rewarded for battle merit, and troops bound for Japan received paper money.

s0225.literal: Second month, on wuchen day four thousand guard troops were dispatched to complete the main hall.
s0225.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen day four thousand guard troops were sent to finish the main hall.

s0226.literal: The armies campaigning against Japan, the skilled archers, and the Goryeo squad leaders and naval troops were granted four thousand ingots of paper money.
s0226.idiomatic: Troops bound for Japan, skilled archers, and Goryeo squad leaders and naval forces received four thousand ingots of paper money.

s0227.literal: On xinwei day the imperial carriage visited Willow Grove.
s0227.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Emperor visited Willow Grove.

s0228.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, having married an imperial princess, asked that the words "imperial son-in-law" be added to his patent of appointment.
s0228.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, having married an imperial princess, asked that the words "imperial son-in-law" be added to his appointment patent.

s0230.literal: " On yihai day an edict ordered that newly built ships of Tamna be handed to Hong Chajiu for the expedition.
s0230.idiomatic: " On yihai day an edict ordered Tamna's newly built ships turned over to Hong Chajiu for the expedition.

s0231.literal: An edict ordered convicts whose death sentences had been commuted handed over to Xindu as soldiers.
s0231.idiomatic: An edict ordered convicts whose death sentences had been commuted assigned to Xindu as soldiers.

s0232.literal: Fire struck Yangzhou; seven hundred eighty-three shi of grain were issued to relieve affected households.
s0232.idiomatic: Fire struck Yangzhou; seven hundred eighty-three shi of grain were issued to households affected by the disaster.

s0233.literal: An edict instructed Fan Wenhu and others on the intent of the campaign against Japan and again strictly enforced military law.
s0233.idiomatic: An edict instructed Fan Wenhu and others on the purpose of the campaign against Japan and again tightened military discipline.

s0234.literal: The Shangdu garrison commissionerate was established.
s0234.idiomatic: The Shangdu garrison commissionerate was established.

s0235.literal: Xu Prefecture was promoted to a route and placed under Anxi Province.
s0235.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture was promoted to a route and placed under Anxi Province.

s0236.literal: The Hunan provincial seat was moved from Tanzhou to E Prefecture, and the Hunan pacification commission was moved to Tanzhou.
s0236.idiomatic: The Hunan provincial seat was moved from Tanzhou to E Prefecture, and the Hunan pacification commission was relocated to Tanzhou.

s0237.literal: On yiyou day the Uyghur judicial office was changed to the Beiting Protectorate and raised to rank two subordinate.
s0237.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Uyghur judicial office was made the Beiting Protectorate and raised to rank two subordinate.

s0238.literal: On bingxu day the army campaigning against Japan set out.
s0238.idiomatic: On bingxu day the army bound for Japan set out.

s0239.literal: Famine struck eastern Zhe; more than one thousand two hundred seventy shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0239.idiomatic: Eastern Zhe suffered famine; more than one thousand two hundred seventy shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0240.literal: On jichou day troops and civilians of Suzhou and other places were dispatched to dig canals and irrigate fields.
s0240.idiomatic: On jichou day troops and civilians in Suzhou and elsewhere were sent to dig canals and irrigate fields.

s0241.literal: The army campaigning against Japan was supplied with clothing, armor, bows and arrows, and sea-hawk tallies.
s0241.idiomatic: Troops bound for Japan were supplied with clothing, armor, bows and arrows, and sea-hawk tallies.

s0242.literal: An edict ordered Transmission Bureau official Huntun and Guo Hanjie to put the water courier stations in order; from Xu Prefecture to Jingnan there were nineteen stations in all, with two thousand one hundred households and two hundred twelve boats added.
s0242.idiomatic: An edict ordered transmission bureau official Huntun and Guo Hanjie to put the water courier stations in order from Xu Prefecture to Jingnan—nineteen stations in all—with two thousand one hundred households and two hundred twelve boats added.

s0243.literal: An edict instructed Wusuo Nakong and others not to disturb Luoshi Ghost Country; violators were to be reported by name to the country lord Aliju.
s0243.idiomatic: An edict instructed Wusuo Nakong and others not to disturb Luoshi Ghost Country; violators were to be reported by name to the country lord Aliju.

s0244.literal: Fujian Province left associate Pu Shougeng said: "An edict ordered two hundred seagoing ships built; only fifty are finished, and the people are truly in hardship.
s0244.idiomatic: Fujian Province left associate Pu Shougeng said, "An edict ordered two hundred seagoing ships built, but only fifty are finished and the people are truly suffering.

s0245.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the work stopped.

s0246.literal: On yiwei day Empress Chabi of the Hongjira clan, styled Empress of Graceful Devotion, Sagely Compliance, Illuminating Heaven, Wise in Letters, and Responsive to Radiance, died.
s0246.idiomatic: On yiwei day Empress Chabi of the Hongjira clan died.

s0247.literal: On bingshen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
s0247.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor returned to the palace.

s0248.literal: An edict summoned Jiang Zongying, thirty-eighth-generation patriarch of Mount Sanmao, to court.
s0248.idiomatic: An edict summoned Jiang Zongying, thirty-eighth-generation patriarch of Mount Sanmao, to court.

s0249.literal: Danbabaike and others were dispatched to the Donghai and Jiyuan temples to perform Buddhist rites.
s0249.idiomatic: Danbabaike and others were sent to the Donghai and Jiyuan temples to perform Buddhist rites.

s0250.literal: Right associate of the Central Secretariat and acting Jiangdong Circuit pacification commissioner Alaghan was made left grand councillor and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs; Jiangxi Circuit pacification commissioner and concurrent campaign commissioner Yeshimishi was made associate administrator and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs.
s0250.idiomatic: Right associate of the Central Secretariat and acting Jiangdong Circuit pacification commissioner Alaghan was made left grand councillor and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs; Jiangxi Circuit pacification commissioner and concurrent campaign commissioner Yeshimishi was made associate administrator and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs.

s0251.literal: Because Liaoyang, Yi, Gai, Bejing, and Dading and other prefectures suffered drought, half of this year's rent and tax was remitted.
s0251.idiomatic: Because Liaoyang, Yi, Gai, Beijing, Dading, and other prefectures suffered drought, half of that year's rent and tax was remitted.

s0252.literal: Third month, on wuxu day Xu Heng died.
s0252.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu day Xu Heng died.

s0253.literal: On jihai day an edict ordered the Anxi branch secretariat for Huang, Ping, and Di and Zhenyuan placed under the Tanzhou branch secretariat; each was to dispatch troops to garrison and defend.
s0253.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict ordered the Anxi branch secretariat for Huang, Ping, and Di and Zhenyuan, now under the Tanzhou branch secretariat, each to dispatch garrison troops.

s0254.literal: On jiachen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan was ordered to perform red writ petitions to Heaven in the palace for seven days and nights.
s0254.idiomatic: On jiachen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan was ordered to perform red writ petitions to Heaven in the palace for seven days and nights.

s0255.literal: On bingwu day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
s0255.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor went to the Upper Capital.

s0256.literal: On bingchen day the Arms Directorate was raised to rank three.
s0256.idiomatic: On bingchen day the arms directorate was raised to rank three.

s0257.literal: On xinyou day the Petition Drum Court was established, permitting those with grievances to strike the drum and be heard.
s0257.idiomatic: On xinyou day the petition drum court was established, allowing those with grievances to strike the drum and be heard.

s0258.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day Yunnan forces were increased to campaign against Helazhang.
s0258.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinwei day Yunnan forces were reinforced for the campaign against Helazhang.

s0259.literal: On guiyou day official salaries at court and throughout the realm were again issued.
s0259.idiomatic: On guiyou day official salaries at court and throughout the realm were restored.

s0260.literal: On xinsi day Tong and Tai Prefectures suffered famine; twenty-one thousand six hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0260.idiomatic: On xinsi day Tong and Tai Prefectures suffered famine; twenty-one thousand six hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0261.literal: On wuzi day a commander-in-chief for Mongol, Han, and newly submitted armies was established.
s0261.idiomatic: On wuzi day a commander-in-chief for Mongol, Han, and newly submitted armies was established.

s0262.literal: On jiawu day an edict ordered Taiyuan's tribute silk delivered directly to Taiyuan.
s0262.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict ordered Taiyuan's tribute silk delivered directly to Taiyuan.

s0263.literal: From Taihe Ridge to Bie Shibali thirty new courier stations were established.
s0263.idiomatic: Thirty new courier stations were set up from Taihe Ridge to Bie Shibali.

s0264.literal: The Hexi army campaigning against Japan and others were granted paper money.
s0264.idiomatic: The Hexi troops bound for Japan and others received paper money.

s0265.literal: Fifth month, on guimao day Muslims along the northwest frontier were forbidden to cross the border to trade.
s0265.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao day Muslims along the northwest frontier were forbidden to cross the border to trade.

s0266.literal: On jiachen day envoys were dispatched to relieve famine in Guazhou and Shazhou.
s0266.idiomatic: On jiachen day envoys were sent to relieve famine in Guazhou and Shazhou.

s0267.literal: On wushen day the Huozhou Uyghur Surveillance Commission was abolished.
s0267.idiomatic: On wushen day the Huozhou Uyghur surveillance commission was abolished.

s0268.literal: On jiyou day wine-making was forbidden in Gansu, Guazhou, Shazhou, and other prefectures.
s0268.idiomatic: On jiyou day wine-making was forbidden in Gansu, Guazhou, Shazhou, and other prefectures.

s0269.literal: On renzi day Tamna was exempted from this year's tribute of white ramie.
s0269.idiomatic: On renzi day Tamna was exempted from that year's tribute of white ramie.

s0270.literal: On bingchen day the Wumeng Amou Pacification Commission was placed under the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
s0270.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Wumeng Amou pacification commission was placed under the Yunnan branch secretariat.

s0272.literal: On gengshen day the prohibition on selling persons was strictly enforced, and those lacking food were given relief according to measure.
s0272.idiomatic: On gengshen day the ban on selling persons was strictly enforced, and those without food received measured relief.

s0273.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered a registration of Khitan households.
s0273.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered Khitan households registered.

s0274.literal: An edict to Tamna darughachi Targhachi forbade hunting in Goryeo's Jeolla and other districts that disturbed the people.
s0274.idiomatic: An edict to Tamna darughachi Targhachi forbade hunting in Goryeo's Jeolla and other districts that disturbed the people.

s0275.literal: Sixth month, on bingyin day an edict ordered Sayyid Ajall and Huonichi separately to administer the households of eight places including Wumu and Baduqi'er.
s0275.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin day an edict ordered Sayyid Ajall and Huonichi to administer separately the households of eight districts including Wumu and Baduqi'er.

s0276.literal: One hundred forty-two weaving households of Qianzhou were extremely poor; grain was given them, and wives and children they had sold were redeemed and returned by the government.
s0276.idiomatic: One hundred forty-two weaving households in Qianzhou were destitute; grain was issued to them, and wives and children they had sold were redeemed and returned by the government.

s0277.literal: Five thousand newly submitted troops from Taiyuan were sent to garrison-farm at Ganzhou.
s0277.idiomatic: Five thousand newly submitted troops from Taiyuan were sent to garrison-farm at Ganzhou.

s0278.literal: On dingchou day forty-eight thousand shi of surplus grain impeached by the surveillance commission were used to feed the army.
s0278.idiomatic: On dingchou day forty-eight thousand shi of surplus grain exposed by the surveillance commission were used to feed the army.

s0279.literal: On jimao day Shunqing Route was placed under the Sichuan East Circuit Pacification Commission.
s0279.idiomatic: On jimao day Shunqing Route was placed under the Sichuan East Circuit pacification commission.

s0280.literal: At military courier stations in Anxi and other places, all labor requisitions and government purchases were to be shared equally with the people.
s0280.idiomatic: At military courier stations in Anxi and elsewhere, all labor requisitions and government purchases were to be shared equally with the people.

s0281.literal: Shaanxi garrison-farm grain was increased by one hundred thousand shi to meet regular expenses.
s0281.idiomatic: Shaanxi garrison-farm grain was increased by one hundred thousand shi for regular expenses.

s0282.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered Tamna garrison troops to farm for their own support.
s0282.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered Tamna garrison troops to farm for their own support.

s0283.literal: Officials of the Japan Route Secretariat sent envoys saying: "The main army is stationed on Gyeongju Island; reaching Tsushima they captured islanders who said that sixty li west of Dazaifu there had formerly been a garrison force already called out to battle — it would be well to strike while the place is empty.
s0283.idiomatic: Officials of the Japan route secretariat sent word: "The main army is on Gyeongju Island; at Tsushima they captured islanders who said that sixty li west of Dazaifu a garrison force had already been called out to battle—it would be well to strike while the place is empty.

s0284.literal: " An edict stated: "Military affairs are for you to weigh yourselves.
s0284.idiomatic: " An edict read, "Military affairs are for you to weigh yourselves.

s0285.literal: " On guiwei day the Central Secretariat was ordered to calculate the government outlays and annual receipts of the Lian and Hai garrison farms under Yao Yan's command; if feasible they were to proceed, otherwise they were to be abolished.
s0285.idiomatic: " On guiwei day the Central Secretariat was ordered to calculate government outlays and annual receipts from the Lian and Hai garrison farms under Yao Yan; if feasible they would continue, otherwise they would be abolished.

s0286.literal: On dinghai day seven thousand hunter households recruited by Qichi were released as civilians.
s0286.idiomatic: On dinghai day seven thousand hunter households recruited by Qichi were released as civilians.

s0287.literal: On gengyin day, because Alaghan was ill, an edict ordered Atahai to command the army and horses campaigning against Japan.
s0287.idiomatic: On gengyin day, because Alaghan was ill, an edict ordered Atahai to take command of the army campaigning against Japan.

s0288.literal: On renchen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo said his country had established forty courier stations and the people and livestock were exhausted; an edict combined them into twenty stations and also granted eight hundred ingots for horse costs.
s0288.idiomatic: On renchen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo said his country had forty courier stations and the people and livestock were exhausted; an edict reduced them to twenty stations and granted eight hundred ingots for horse costs.

s0289.literal: Envoys to Musur, Suraman and others, reached Champa with their ship wrecked; they sent men to report and ask for boats, grain, and additional troops; an edict granted more than one thousand four hundred shi of grain.
s0289.idiomatic: Suraman and others, envoys to Musur, reached Champa with their ship wrecked; they sent men to ask for boats, grain, and reinforcements; an edict granted more than one thousand four hundred shi of grain.

s0290.literal: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Hudutemür was made right associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs;
s0290.idiomatic: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Hudutemür was made right associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs;

s0291.literal: Censor-in-chief and acting censorate commissioner Hulachu was made left associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of the Ministry of Works affairs.
s0291.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief and acting censorate commissioner Hulachu was made left associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of Ministry of Works affairs.

s0292.literal: Paper money for sheep and horse costs was granted to the artisans under Prince Namkha.
s0292.idiomatic: Paper money for sheep and horse costs was granted to artisans under Prince Namkha.

s0293.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the jiawu new moon, wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to detach one thousand Han troops garrisoned at Suzhou under pacification commissioner Liu En and enter Bie Shibali, with one hundred soldiers who had once passed through West Sichuan as guides.
s0293.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jiawu new moon, wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to detach one thousand Han troops garrisoned at Suzhou under pacification commissioner Liu En and enter Bie Shibali, guided by one hundred soldiers who had once passed through West Sichuan.

s0294.literal: On dingyou day an edict ordered a grain office established at Ganzhou to supply military grain.
s0294.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered a grain office set up at Ganzhou to supply military grain.

s0295.literal: The Jingzhao and Sichuan branch secretariats were separately established west of the river at Hexi.
s0295.idiomatic: Separate Jingzhao and Sichuan branch secretariats were established west of the river at Hexi.

s0297.literal: On gengzi day Muslim catapult makers scattered in other prefectures were all ordered to go to Nanjing to garrison-farm.
s0297.idiomatic: On gengzi day Muslim catapult makers scattered in other prefectures were all ordered to Nanjing to garrison-farm.

s0298.literal: On guimao day the moon transited the distance star of the Fang mansion.
s0298.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transited the distance star of the Fang mansion.

s0299.literal: On gengxu day, because the Mongol troops Xindu had garrisoned at Dahe Ridge were returning, Han troops were again ordered to garrison and defend.
s0299.idiomatic: On gengxu day, with the Mongol troops Xindu had garrisoned at Dahe Ridge returning, Han troops were again ordered to garrison the post.

s0300.literal: Because Songzhou prefect Pusantuoge had shot tigers numbering in the tens of thousands before and after, he was granted the title General of Ten Thousand Tigers.
s0300.idiomatic: Because Songzhou prefect Pusantuoge had killed tigers by the tens of thousands over the years, he was granted the title General of Ten Thousand Tigers.
